title.zh: 信号检测论 · 敏感度 d′ 与判据
title.en: Signal detection theory · sensitivity d′ and criterion

description.zh: 每次判断“有没有”背后都有一个随机起伏的证据强度：有信号时整体偏高，没信号时偏低；能把两者分多开叫敏感度 d′，多愿意说“有”叫判据 c——移动判据只是用漏报换虚报，只有 d′ 才代表真正的分辨力，两个人正确率一样，d′ 也可以不同。
description.en: Behind every yes/no judgement is a randomly varying strength of evidence, higher on average when a signal is present; how far apart the two cases are is the sensitivity d′, and how willing one is to say “yes” is the criterion c — moving the criterion only trades misses for false alarms, only d′ measures real discrimination, and two observers with the same accuracy can differ in d′.

aliases.en: hit rate and false alarm rate

label.en: Two normal curves of equal width

reason.zh: 模型假设噪声和信号下的证据强度都是正态分布、宽度相同；d′ 就是两条钟形曲线的中心相距几个标准差，z(H) − z(F) 用标准正态把比例换回位置。
reason.en: The model assumes evidence strength is normally distributed, with equal width, both with and without the signal; d′ is how many standard deviations apart the two bell curves’ centres are, and z(H) − z(F) uses the standard normal to turn proportions back into positions.

label.en: A false alarm is a Type I error

reason.zh: 统计检验也是在噪声里判断有没有效应：显著性水平 α 对应虚报率，检验力对应命中率；收紧判据少犯一种错，就得多犯另一种。
reason.en: A statistical test also decides whether an effect stands out from noise: the significance level α plays the false-alarm rate and the power the hit rate; tightening the criterion to make one error rarer makes the other more common.

label.en: Choose the criterion by expected cost

reason.zh: 每次试验的期望代价 = p·(1−H)·m + (1−p)·F·f；漏报越贵、信号越常见，代价最低的判据就越宽松——最好的判据不在正中间。
reason.en: The expected cost per trial is p·(1−H)·m + (1−p)·F·f; the costlier a miss and the commoner the signal, the more lenient the cheapest criterion — the best criterion is not in the middle.

question.zh: 两位检测者都对了 80%，为什么分辨能力可能不一样？
question.en: Two detectors are both 80% correct — how can they differ in how well they discriminate?

ask.zh: 有信号和没信号时的证据强度各是一条钟形曲线，它们离得越远意味着什么？
ask.en: Evidence with and without a signal forms two bell curves; what does it mean when they are farther apart?

ask.zh: 把判据左右移，命中率和虚报率会怎样一起变？
ask.en: Moving the criterion left or right, how do the hit and false-alarm rates change together?

reveal.zh: 正确率混合了两件事：分得清（d′，两条分布离多远）和多愿意说“有”（判据 c）。一个人可以靠判据把正确率凑到 80%，另一个靠更大的 d′；用 d′ = z(H) − z(F) 拆开，或在 ROC 曲线上比谁更鼓向左上角，才看得出谁更会分辨。
reveal.en: Accuracy mixes two things: telling apart (d′, how far apart the distributions are) and willingness to say yes (the criterion c). One observer can reach 80% through the criterion, another through a larger d′; separating them with d′ = z(H) − z(F), or seeing whose ROC curve bows further to the upper left, shows who discriminates better.
